fields.main_text:
Biomed Ingredients Australia is committed towards good health and protection of the environment.

When Bio-Med Ingredients was born in 2014, our mission has been to manufacture and supply organically produced medicinal plants to the nutritional, cosmetic, pharmaceutical and food industries.

We live in an era, where health is not wealth but it is seen as a means of making wealth. Conventional farming is literally killing our well-being and ecology. In order to increase the yield exponentially, harsh and hostile chemicals are introduced into farming. This has not just damaged our soil and water but has introduced a host of new diseases that are affecting both man and animals.
fields.mission_text: To deliver superior natural ingredients that meet global standards, fostering health and sustainability.
fields.vision_text: To be the leading global provider of natural ingredients, driving innovation and responsible sourcing.
fields.values_text: Integrity, Quality, Innovation, Sustainability, Customer Focus.
fields.middle_text:
IFOAM – Organics International (an organization that promotes organic farming) says, “Organic Agriculture is a production of a system that sustains the health of soils, ecosystems, and people. It relies on ecological processes, biodiversity and cycles adapted to local conditions, rather than the use of inputs with adverse effects. Organic Agriculture combines tradition, innovation, and science to benefit the shared environment and promote fair relationships and good quality of life for all involved.”

Therefore, we strictly stand against synthetic products. Since we are into the business of supplying medicinal plants, we took the organic route to cultivate these herbs. With the help of our well-experienced R&D team, we have embraced an environment-friendly method of agronomy which uses organic supplementation instead of chemical fertilization. Our farmers also follow the Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) instituted by the Food and Agricultural Organization of the United Nations (FAO).

The use of natural products as a source of a compound in drug discovery is gaining momentum. Synthetic drugs address the symptoms of a disease, but natural drugs augment the body’s own healing system.
​
Our process of extracting the raw materials from plant source adheres to certified standards. We inspect random samples of raw materials before every production cycle. This guarantees the production of crème de la crème of herbal extracts.

fields.hero_subtitle: Giving back to the community and nurturing the environment for a sustainable future.
fields.intro_content:
Our global CR policy focuses on four key areas where we believe we can make the most difference.

For three of these – Industry, Environment and People – we have established a global framework for our operating companies to work within, allowing them flexibility over which area to invest in according to what will have the most meaning and impact locally.

Whilst local legal standards apply as an absolute minimum, we aim to achieve good practice in our local markets and share this across the Group. The fourth area – Community – is entirely locally driven, allowing our people to support causes close to them and to become involved in their communities.
fields.pillar_1_content: We aim to leverage the unique relationships that we have with our customers across the globe to continue to understand and support the issues and challenges that they face.
fields.pillar_2_content: We continue to analyse our impact on our environment. We remain committed to reducing our energy consumption and related emissions where possible, as well as reducing our wider impacts such as resource use and waste to landfill.
fields.pillar_3_content: We have a Code of Ethics which recognizes the importance of treating all of our employees fairly, covering issues such as responsible employment, diversity and equal opportunities. This is an effective way of communicating, at a high level, the principles which should be applied in the conduct of our business.
fields.pillar_4_content: Our local communities are important to us. We support a number of charities and community organisations worldwide in order to make a positive impact on the communities where we have a presence.
fields.pillar_5_content: As a part of corporate social responsibility, we at Biomed Ingredients has started a program called the “Green Initiative”. We care for the mother nature and with this initiative, we are involving each and every human being directly or indirectly in saving our planet.

fields.name: Mr. Sebastian Thomas
fields.bio: Mr. Sebastian Thomas is an entrepreneur and business leader whose professional journey reflects a blend of industry experience and entrepreneurial vision. Originally from Kerala and currently based in Goa, he holds a degree in Business Management. His career began with Toyota Kirloskar in Bengaluru, followed by professional assignments with Sami Labs, Deutsch India, ABB and Pentair Water. In 2016, he established Bio Med Ingredients Private Limited in Goa, marking an important milestone in his entrepreneurial career. His professional interests include business development, international trade and the evolving field of natural botanical ingredients. Beyond his professional commitments, Mr. Sebastian has a keen interest in organic farming, sustainable agriculture and environmentally responsible farming practices. He is also associated with several organisations engaged in social welfare and community development initiatives.

fields.name: Mrs. Savitha B Pillai
fields.bio: Mrs. Savitha B. Pillai is an entrepreneur with an academic background in Economics, professional experience in education and a keen interest in nature and natural products. She holds a Bachelor’s and postgraduate degree in Economics from Madras Christian College, Tambaram, along with a Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.). Her appreciation for nature and interest in the potential of natural ingredients led her to explore entrepreneurship. In 2016, she co-founded Bio Med Ingredients Private Limited alongside Mr. Sebastian Thomas. She currently serves as the company’s full-time Director, contributing to its management and development. She brings a clear sense of purpose to her role, with a strong commitment to organisational growth, responsible leadership and the long-term vision of the enterprise.

fields.name: Mrs. Ania Martian
fields.bio: Ania Martian is the Founder and CEO of BM Ingredients Europe GmbH. With extensive international experience in sales, import and export, customer development, and botanical ingredients, she leads the company’s commercial strategy and international growth. Her strong product knowledge, multilingual background, and hands-on approach enable her to build lasting relationships with customers, suppliers, and partners across global markets. Ania is focused on combining reliable service, market expertise, and long-term partnerships to create sustainable growth for BM Ingredients Europe and its customers.

fields.quality_text_1:
Quality at Bio Med Ingredients is guided by a structured, science-led framework. It is upheld through disciplined sourcing, controlled manufacturing systems and evidence-based evaluation. Our focus is to ensure that every ingredient we supply meets defined standards of identity, purity and performance.

We work with trusted cultivation and raw material partners who follow responsible agricultural and post-harvest practices. All incoming materials undergo authentication and verification before processing, ensuring consistency and traceability from the point of origin.
fields.quality_text_2:
Our manufacturing operations are supported by a DSIR Recognised R and D Unit, equipped to conduct analytical validation, formulation studies and continuous process improvement. The R and D unit works closely with production and quality teams to enhance extraction efficiency, maintain fingerprint consistency and reinforce product stability. This scientific foundation strengthens reliability across our supply chain.

Production is carried out in controlled environments with standardised operating procedures and monitored processing lines. Quality assessment includes raw material evaluation, in-process checks and final product testing using validated analytical methods. Parameters covered include identity, purity, microbial safety, heavy metal limits and pesticide residue compliance, aligned with globally accepted regulatory expectations.
fields.quality_text_3:
Documentation, batch traceability and specification transparency form a critical part of our quality assurance system. We maintain readiness for regulatory review and partner audits, reinforcing confidence in every supply.

For Bio Med Ingredients, quality is not an isolated function. It is an organisational discipline supported by trained teams, scientific capability and operational integrity. It is the standard we commit to consistently and the promise we uphold in every partnership.

fields.preclinical_studies: Pre-clinical studies were conducted for PureBeanFit® in comparison to normal marketed green coffee bean extract at PRADO Pune. The objective of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of the Extract in Streptozotocin induced diabetes in Sprague Dawley Rats when administered by Oral route. The animals were kept for overnight fasting for approximately 16-14 hours. The streptozotocin (60 mg/kg IP) was injected by intraperitoneal route as a single dose on day 1 to induce diabetes. Animals will be screened for development of hyperglycaemia (fasting blood glucose >250 mg/kg) for 5 days after streptozotocin injection. The dose volume will not be exceeding 10 ml/kg body weight and actual volume to be administered were calculated based on the body weights of each animal.
